schema.source: TCPK-curated basename subset of well-known BYOVD-flagged drivers (LOLDrivers project: github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers).
schema.notes: Basenames only. SHA-256 hashes are DELIBERATELY OMITTED here because no invented hashes are ever shipped in TCPK per the prime directive. To fire the SHA-256 branch of driver.byovd-loldrivers-match, place a full LOLDrivers export at TCPK/Data/loldrivers-full.json (or set -LolDriversPath on the cmdlet); the cmdlet computes each shipped .sys hash and looks it up there. This curated file is the always-on basename floor.

entries.name: windrvr6.sys
entries.why: Arbitrary physical memory / MSR / port IO IOCTLs. Also caught by driver.jungo-windriver-shipped.

entries.name: capcom.sys
entries.why: Kernel-mode exec-any-pointer IOCTL (the original BYOVD case).

entries.name: gdrv.sys
entries.why: Arbitrary physmem write - abused by Slingshot, RobbinHood, Uroburos.

entries.name: asrdrv102.sys
entries.why: Same family as asrdrv101; version drift.

entries.name: rtcore64.sys
entries.why: Arbitrary MSR / physmem - used in RobbinHood, PatchGuard-bypass PoCs.

entries.name: procexp152.sys
entries.why: Historic CVE-2019-16098-shape kernel read/write on old versions.

entries.name: acefile.sys
entries.why: Arbitrary code exec in kernel via IOCTL.
